一个人一款命。.trs: Tsi̍t ê lâng tsi̍t khuán miā.

一个囡仔較鬧熱三个大人。.trs: Tsi̍t ê gín-á khah lāu jia̍t sann ê tuā-lâng.

一个某較好三个天公祖。.trs: Tsi̍t ê bóo khah hó sann ê Thinn-kong-tsóo.

一个錢拍二十四个結。.trs: Tsi̍t ê tsînn phah jī-tsa̍p-sì ê kat.

一人一家代，公媽隨人祀。.trs: Tsi̍t lâng tsi̍t ke tāi, kong-má suî lâng tshāi.

一人煩惱一樣，無人煩惱親像。.trs: Tsi̍t lâng huân-ló tsi̍t iūnn, bô-lâng huân-ló tshin-tshiūnn.

一人看出一家，新婦看出大家。.trs: Tsi̍t lâng khuànn-tshut tsi̍t ke, sin-pū khuànn-tshut ta-ke.

一代親，二代表，三代毋捌了了。.trs: It tāi tshin, jī tāi piáu, sann tāi m̄ bat liáu-liáu.

一兼二顧，摸蜊仔兼洗褲。.trs: It kiam jī kòo, bong lâ-á kiam sé khòo.

一分錢，一分貨。.trs: Tsi̍t hun tsînn, tsi̍t hun huè.

一千賒毋值八百現。.trs: Tsi̍t tshing sia m̄-ta̍t peh pah hiān.

一句話三角六尖。.trs: Tsi̍t kù uē sann kak la̍k tsiam.

一年換二十四个頭家。.trs: Tsi̍t nî uānn jī-tsa̍p-sì ê thâu-ke.

一斗較贏九石。.trs: Tsi̍t táu khah iânn káu tsio̍h.

一日剃頭，三日緣投。.trs: Tsi̍t ji̍t thì-thâu, sann ji̍t iân-tâu.

一日徙栽，三日徛黃。.trs: Tsi̍t ji̍t suá tsai, sann ji̍t khiā n̂g.

一日討海，三日曝網。.trs: Tsi̍t ji̍t thó-hái, sann ji̍t pha̍k bāng.

一日走拋拋，一暝點燈膋。.trs: Tsi̍t ji̍t tsáu-pha-pha, tsi̍t mê tiám ting-lâ.

一暝全頭路，天光無半步。.trs: Tsi̍t mê tsuân thâu-lōo, thinn-kng bô-puànn-pōo.

一枝草，一點露。.trs: Tsi̍t ki tsháu, tsi̍t tiám lōo.

一某無人知，兩某相卸代。.trs: Tsi̍t bóo bô-lâng tsai, nn̄g bóo sio-sià-tāi.

一樣米飼百樣人。.trs: Tsi̍t iūnn bí tshī pah-iūnn lâng.

一步棋，一步著。.trs: Tsi̍t pōo kî, tsi̍t pōo tio̍h.

一粒田螺煮九碗公湯。.trs: Tsi̍t lia̍p tshân-lê tsú káu uánn-kong thng.

一粒米，百粒汗。.trs: Tsi̍t lia̍p bí, pah lia̍p kuānn.

一耳空入，一耳空出。.trs: Tsi̍t hīnn-khang ji̍p, tsi̍t hīnn-khang tshut.

一遍賊，百世賊。.trs: Tsi̍t piàn tsha̍t, pah sì tsha̍t.

一錢，二緣，三媠，四少年。.trs: It tshiân, jī iân, sann suí, sì siàu-liân.

一隻牛剝雙領皮。.trs: Tsi̍t tsiah gû pak siang niá phuê.

一隻蝨母嗙甲水牛大。.trs: Tsi̍t tsiah sat-bó pòng kah tsuí-gû tuā.

一面抹壁雙面光。.trs: Tsi̍t bīn buah-piah siang bīn kng.

七坐八爬九發牙。.trs: Tshit tsē peh pê káu huat-gê.

三人共五目，日後無長短跤話。.trs: Sann lâng kāng gōo ba̍k, ji̍t-āu bô tn̂g-té-kha-uē.

三代粒積，一代窮空。.trs: Sann tāi lia̍p-tsik, tsi̍t tāi khîng-khong.

三分人，七分妝。.trs: Sann hun lâng, tshit hun tsng.

三年一閏，好歹照輪。.trs: Sann nî tsi̍t jūn, hó-pháinn tsiàu lûn.

三日無餾，𬦰上樹。.trs: Sann ji̍t bô liū, peh-tsiūnn tshiū.

三百六十行，行行出狀元。.trs: Sann-pah la̍k-tsa̍p hâng, hâng-hâng tshut tsiōng-guân.

上山看山勢，入門看人意。.trs: Tsiūnn suann khuànn suann-sì, ji̍p-mn̂g khuànn lâng ì.

上踏枋，上眠床，無洗跤睏中央。.trs: Tsiūnn ta̍h-pang, tsiūnn bîn-tshn̂g, bô sé kha khùn tiong-ng.

乞食也有三年好運。.trs: Khit-tsia̍h iā ū sann nî hó-ūn.

也著箠，也著糜。.trs: Iā tio̍h tshuê, iā tio̍h muê.

了錢生理無人做，刣頭生理有人做。.trs: Liáu-tsînn sing-lí bô lâng tsò, thâi-thâu sing-lí ū lâng tsò.

五肢指頭仔伸出來無平長。.trs: Gōo ki tsíng-thâu-á tshun--tshut-lâi bô pênn tn̂g.

人兩跤，錢四跤。.trs: Lâng nn̄g kha, tsînn sì kha.

人咧做，天咧看。.trs: Lâng teh tsò, thinn teh khuànn.

人情世事陪到到，無鼎閣無灶。.trs: Jîn-tsîng-sè-sū puê kàu-kàu, bô tiánn koh bô tsàu.

人情留一線，日後好相看。.trs: Jîn-tsîng lâu tsi̍t suànn, ji̍t-āu hó sio-khuànn.

人未到，聲先到。.trs: Lâng buē kàu, siann sing kàu.

人濟話就濟，三色人講五色話。.trs: Lâng tsē uē tō tsē, sam sik lâng kóng ngóo sik uē.

人無照天理，天無照甲子。.trs: Lâng bô tsiàu thinn-lí, thinn bô tsiàu kah-tsí.

人牽毋行，鬼牽溜溜行。.trs: Lâng khan m̄ kiânn, kuí khan liù-liù-kiânn.

人的喙，掩袂密。.trs: Lâng ê tshuì, am bē ba̍t.

人若衰，種匏仔生菜瓜。.trs: Lâng nā sue, tsìng pû-á senn tshài-kue.

人飼人，一支骨；天飼人，肥朒朒。.trs: Lâng tshī lâng, tsi̍t ki kut; thinn tshī lâng, puî-tsut-tsut.

仙人拍鼓有時錯，跤步踏差啥人無？.trs: Sian-jîn phah kóo iú sî tshò, kha-pōo ta̍h-tsha siánn-lâng bô?

仙拚仙，害死猴齊天。.trs: Sian piànn sian, hāi-sí Kâu Tsê-thian.

倖豬夯灶，倖囝不孝。.trs: Sīng ti giâ tsàu, sīng kiánn put-hàu.

做官若清廉，食飯著攪鹽。.trs: Tsò kuann nā tshing-liâm, tsia̍h-pn̄g tio̍h kiáu iâm.

做官騙厝內，做生理騙熟似。.trs: Tsò kuann phiàn tshù-lāi, tsò-sing-lí phiàn si̍k-sāi.

做戲的欲煞，看戲的毋煞。.trs: Tsò-hì--ê beh suah, khuànn-hì--ê m̄ suah.

做牛著拖，做人著磨。.trs: Tsò gû tio̍h thua, tsò-lâng tio̍h buâ.

做著歹田望下冬，娶著歹某一世人。.trs: Tsò-tio̍h pháinn tshân bāng ē tang, tshuā-tio̍h pháinn bóo tsi̍t-sì-lâng.

僥倖錢，失德了；冤枉錢，跋輸筊。.trs: Hiau-hīng-tsînn, sit-tik liáu, uan-óng-tsînn, pua̍h-su kiáu.

兄弟若仝心，烏塗變成金。.trs: Hiann-tī nā kāng sim, oo-thôo piàn-sîng kim.

入人門，順人意。.trs: Ji̍p lâng mn̂g, sūn lâng ì.

入虎口，無死也烏漚。.trs: Ji̍p hóo kháu, bô sí iā oo-áu.

分袂平，拍甲二九暝。.trs: Pun bē pênn, phah kah Jī-káu-mê.

別人的囝死袂了。.trs: Pa̍t-lâng ê kiánn sí bē liáu.

勸人做好代，較贏食早齋。.trs: Khǹg lâng tsò hó tāi, khah-iânn tsia̍h tsá-tsai.

勸恁有孝千萬句，袂曉有孝豬狗牛。.trs: Khǹg lín iú-hàu tshian-bān kù, bē-hiáu iú-hàu ti káu gû.

十二月食菜頭，六月才轉嗽。.trs: Tsa̍p-jī-gue̍h tsia̍h tshài-thâu, la̍k-gue̍h tsiah tńg-sàu.

十囝十新婦，賰一个老寡婦。.trs: Tsa̍p kiánn tsa̍p sin-pū, tshun tsi̍t ê lāu kuá-hū.

十指伸出，無平長。.trs: Tsa̍p tsáinn tshun-tshut, bô pênn tn̂g.

千算萬算，毋值天一劃。.trs: Tshian sǹg bān sǹg, m̄-ta̍t thinn tsi̍t ue̍h.

千途萬途，毋值得翻田塗。.trs: Tshian tôo bān tôo, m̄ ta̍t-tit huan tshân thôo.

千金買厝，萬金買厝邊。.trs: Tshian kim bé tshù, bān kim bé tshù-pinn.

嚴官府出厚賊；嚴爸母出阿里不達。.trs: Giâm kuann-hú tshut kāu tsha̍t; giâm pē-bú tshut a-lí-put-ta̍t.

圓人會扁，扁人會圓。.trs: Înn--lâng ē pínn, pínn--lâng ē înn.

在生一粒豆，較贏死了拜豬頭。.trs: Tsāi-senn tsi̍t lia̍p tāu, khah iânn sí-liáu pài ti-thâu.

坐予正，得人疼。.trs: Tsē hōo tsiànn, tit lâng thiànn.

外甥食母舅，親像食豆腐。.trs: Guē-sing tsia̍h bú-kū, tshin-tshiūnn tsia̍h tāu-hū.

大人儉一喙，囡仔食甲飫。.trs: Tuā-lâng khiām tsi̍t tshuì, gín-á tsia̍h kah uì.

大人愛趁錢，囡仔愛過年。.trs: Tuā-lâng ài thàn-tsînn, gín-á ài kuè-nî.

大人生日食肉，囡仔生日食拍。.trs: Tuā-lâng senn-ji̍t tsia̍h bah, gín-á senn-ji̍t tsia̍h phah.

大狗盤牆，細狗看樣。.trs: Tuā káu puânn tshiûnn, sè káu khuànn-iūnn.

大紅花毋知䆀，圓仔花䆀毋知。.trs: Tuā-âng-hue m̄ tsai bái, înn-á-hue bái m̄ tsai.

大鼎未滾，細鼎沖沖滾。.trs: Tuā tiánn buē kún, sè tiánn tshiâng-tshiâng-kún.

好也一句，歹也一句。.trs: Hó iā tsi̍t kù, pháinn iā tsi̍t kù.

好囝毋免濟，濟囝餓死爸。.trs: Hó kiánn m̄-bián tsē, tsē kiánn gō-sí pē.

好好鱟刣甲屎那流。.trs: Hó-hó hāu thâi kah sái ná lâu.

好歹在心內，喙脣皮相款待。.trs: Hó-pháinn tsāi sim-lāi, tshuì-tûn-phuê sio khuán-thāi.

好額毋值著會食，好命毋值著勇健。.trs: Hó-gia̍h m̄-ta̍t-tio̍h ē tsia̍h, hó miā m̄-ta̍t-tio̍h ióng-kiānn.

媒人保入房，無保一世人。.trs: Muê-lâng pó ji̍p pâng, bô pó tsi̍t-sì-lâng.

媠䆀無比止，愛著較慘死。.trs: Suí bái bô pí tsí, ài-tio̍h khah-tshám sí.

嫁雞綴雞飛，嫁狗綴狗走。.trs: Kè ke tuè ke pue, kè káu tuè káu tsáu.

嫌貨才是買貨人。.trs: Hiâm huè tsiah sī bé huè lâng.

家和萬事興，家亂萬世窮。.trs: Ka hô bān-sū hing, ka luān bān-sè kîng.

家己栽一欉，較贏看別人。.trs: Ka-kī tsai tsi̍t tsâng, khah iânn khuànn pa̍t-lâng.

少年若無一擺戇，路邊哪有有應公。.trs: Siàu-liân nā bô tsi̍t pái gōng, lōo-pinn ná ū Iú-ìng-kong.

尪姨順話尾，假童害眾人。.trs: Ang-î sūn uē-bué, ké tâng hāi tsìng-lâng.

弓蕉吐囝為囝死。.trs: King-tsio thòo kiánn uī kiánn sí.

徛懸山，看馬相踢。.trs: Khiā kuân suann, khuànn bé sio that.

心歹無人知，喙歹上厲害。.trs: Sim pháinn bô lâng tsai, tshuì pháinn siōng lī-hāi.

惜花連盆，疼囝連孫。.trs: Sioh hue liân phûn, thiànn kiánn liân sun.

惹熊惹虎，毋通惹著刺查某。.trs: Jiá hîm jiá hóo, m̄-thang jiá-tio̍h tshiah-tsa-bóo.

戇的也有一項會。.trs: Gōng--ê iā ū tsi̍t hāng ē.

戲棚跤徛久就是你的。.trs: Hì-pênn kha khiā kú tō sī lí ê.

戲館邊的豬母，袂歕簫嘛會拍拍。.trs: Hì-kuán pinn ê ti-bó, bē pûn siau mā ē phah-phik.

手抱孩兒，才知爸母時。.trs: Tshiú phō hâi-jî, tsiah tsai pē-bú sî.

拍虎掠賊也著親兄弟。.trs: Phah hóo lia̍h tsha̍t iā tio̍h tshin hiann-tī.

捷罵袂聽，捷拍袂疼。.trs: Tsia̍p mē bē thiann, tsia̍p phah bē thiànn.

掃地掃壁角，洗面洗耳空。.trs: Sàu-tè sàu piah-kak, sé-bīn sé hīnn-khang.

揀啊揀，揀著一个賣龍眼。.trs: Kíng--ah kíng, kíng-tio̍h tsi̍t ê bē lîng-gíng.

搖人無才，搖豬無刣。.trs: Iô lâng bô-tsâi, iô ti bô thâi.

攑頭三尺有神明。.trs: Gia̍h thâu sann tshioh ū sîn-bîng.

收瀾收予焦，予你生一个有.trs: Siu-nuā siu hōo ta, hōo lí senn tsi̍t ê ū lān-pha.

教豬教狗，不如家己走。.trs: Kà ti kà káu, put-jû ka-kī tsáu.

敢做匏桸，就毋通驚水燙。.trs: Kánn tsò pû-hia, tō m̄-thang kiann tsuí thǹg.

斷掌查埔做相公，斷掌查某守空房。.trs: Tn̄g-tsiúnn tsa-poo tsò siùnn-kang, tn̄g-tsiúnn tsa-bóo tsiú-khang-pâng.

日頭赤焱焱，隨人顧性命。.trs: Ji̍t-thâu tshiah-iānn-iānn, suî lâng kòo sènn-miā.

春天後母面，欲變一時間。.trs: Tshun-thinn āu-bú bīn, beh piàn tsi̍t sî-kan.

春雺曝死鬼，夏雺做大水。.trs: Tshun bông pha̍k-sí kuí, hā bông tsò-tuā-tsuí.

時到時擔當，無米才煮番薯湯。.trs: Sî kàu sî tam-tng, bô bí tsiah tsú han-tsî thng.

暗頓減食一口，活甲九十九。.trs: Àm-tǹg kiám tsia̍h tsi̍t kháu, ua̍h kah káu-tsa̍p-káu.

會咬人的狗袂吠。.trs: Ē kā--lâng ê káu bē puī.

會曉偷食，袂曉拭喙。.trs: Ē-hiáu thau tsia̍h, bē-hiáu tshit tshuì.

會生得囝身，袂生得囝心。.trs: Ē senn tit kiánn sin, bē senn tit kiánn sim.

有一好，無兩好。.trs: Ū tsi̍t hó, bô nn̄g hó.

有唐山公，無唐山媽。.trs: Ū tn̂g-suann kong, bô tn̂g-suann má.

有喙講甲無瀾。.trs: Ū tshuì kóng kah bô nuā.

有囝有囝命，無囝天註定。.trs: Ū kiánn ū kiánn miā, bô kiánn thinn tsù-tiānn.

有樣看樣，無樣家己想。.trs: Ū iūnn khuànn iūnn, bô iūnn ka-kī siūnn.

有燒香有保庇，有食藥有行氣。.trs: Ū sio-hiunn ū pó-pì, ū tsia̍h io̍h ū kiânn-khì.

有狀元學生，無狀元先生。.trs: Ū tsiōng-guân ha̍k-sing, bô tsiōng-guân sian-sinn.

未曾學行先學飛，未曾掖種想挽瓜。.trs: Buē-tsîng o̍h kiânn sing o̍h pue, buē-tsîng iā-tsíng siūnn bán kue.

未食五日節粽，破裘毋甘放。.trs: Buē tsia̍h Gōo-ji̍t-tseh tsàng, phuà hiû m̄ kam pàng.

查埔也著疼，查某也著晟。.trs: Tsa-poo iā tio̍h thiànn, tsa-bóo iā tio̍h tshiânn.

查埔囝得田園，查某囝得嫁粧。.trs: Tsa-poo-kiánn tit tshân-hn̂g, tsa-bóo-kiánn tit kè-tsng.

棚頂做甲流汗，棚跤嫌甲流瀾。.trs: Pênn tíng tsò kah lâu-kuānn, pênn kha hiâm kah lâu-nuā.

樹頭徛予在，毋驚樹尾做風颱。.trs: Tshiū-thâu khiā hōo tsāi, m̄ kiann tshiū-bué tsò-hong-thai.

欠錢怨債主，不孝怨爸母。.trs: Khiàm tsînn uàn tsè-tsú, put-hàu uàn pē-bú.

欲好額等後世，欲做官學做戲。.trs: Beh hó-gia̍h tán āu-sì, beh tsò-kuann o̍h tsò-hì.

歡歡喜喜一工，煩煩惱惱也一工。.trs: Huann-huann-hí-hí tsi̍t kang, huân-huân-ló-ló iā tsi̍t kang.

歪喙雞食好米。.trs: Uai tshuì ke tsia̍h hó bí.

歹瓜厚子，歹人厚言語。.trs: Pháinn kue kāu-tsí, pháinn-lâng kāu giân-gí.

歹竹出好筍，好竹出痀崙。.trs: Pháinn tik tshut hó sún, hó tik tshut ku-lún.

毛呼龜粿粽，紅包隨你送。.trs: Môo-honn ku kué tsàng, âng-pau suî lí sàng.

毛毛仔雨落久，塗嘛會澹。.trs: Mn̂g-mn̂g-á hōo lo̍h-kú, thôo mā ē tâm.

清明無轉厝，無祖；過年無轉厝，無某。.trs: Tshing-bîng bô tńg tshù, bô tsóo; kuè-nî bô tńg tshù, bô bóo.

無彼號尻川，想欲食彼號瀉藥。.trs: Bô hit-lō kha-tshng, siūnn-beh tsia̍h hit-lō sià-io̍h.

無日毋知晝，無鬚毋知老。.trs: Bô ji̍t m̄ tsai tàu, bô tshiu m̄ tsai lāu.

無禁無忌，食百二。.trs: Bô kìm bô khī, tsia̍h pah-jī.

無米有舂臼，無囝抱新婦。.trs: Bô bí ū tsing-khū, bô kiánn phō sin-pū.

無通生食，哪有通曝乾。.trs: Bô thang tshenn tsia̍h, ná ū thang pha̍k-kuann.

燒瓷的食缺，織蓆的睏椅。.trs: Sio-huî--ê tsia̍h khih, tsit-tshio̍h--ê khùn í.

爛塗袂糊得壁。.trs: Nuā thôo bē kôo tit piah.

爸母疼囝長流水，囝疼爸母樹尾風。.trs: Pē-bú thiànn kiánn tn̂g lâu-tsuí, kiánn thiànn pē-bú tshiū-bué hong.

牛就是牛，牽到北京也是牛。.trs: Gû tō sī gû, khan kàu Pak-kiann iā sī gû.

甘願做牛，毋驚無犁通拖。.trs: Kam-guān tsò gû, m̄ kiann bô lê thang thua.

生囝師仔，飼囝師傅。.trs: Senn kiánn sai-á, tshī kiánn sai-hū.

生的請一邊，養的恩情較大天。.trs: Senn--ê tshiánn tsi̍t pinn, ióng--ê un-tsîng khah tuā thinn.

生雞卵無，放雞屎有。.trs: Senn ke-nn̄g bô, pàng ke-sái ū.

生食都無夠，哪有通曝乾。.trs: Tshenn tsia̍h to bô-kàu, ná ū thang pha̍k-kuann.

用別人的拳頭拇舂石獅。.trs: Iōng pa̍t-lâng ê kûn-thâu-bó tsing tsio̍h-sai.

畫虎畫皮無畫骨，知人知面不知心。.trs: Uē hóo uē phuê bô uē kut, ti jîn ti bīn put ti-sim.

目睭掛斗概，看人物就愛。.trs: Ba̍k-tsiu kuà táu-kài, khuànn lâng mi̍h tō ài.

目睭看佇粿，跤踏著火。.trs: Ba̍k-tsiu khuànn tī kué, kha ta̍h-tio̍h hué.

相分食有賰，相搶食無份。.trs: Sio-pun tsia̍h ū tshun, sio-tshiúnn tsia̍h bô hūn.

相命無褒，食水都無。.trs: Siòng-miā bô po, tsia̍h tsuí to bô.

相罵無揀喙，相拍無揀位。.trs: Sio-mē bô kíng tshuì, sio-phah bô kíng uī.

看人食肉，毋通看人相拍。.trs: Khuànn lâng tsia̍h bah, m̄-thang khuànn lâng sio-phah.

等物僫到，等人快老。.trs: Tán mi̍h oh kàu, tán lâng khuài lāu.

細漢偷挽匏，大漢偷牽牛。.trs: Sè-hàn thau bán pû, tuā-hàn thau khan gû.

細漢煩惱伊袂大，大漢煩惱伊袂娶。.trs: Sè-hàn huân-ló i bē tuā, tuā-hàn huân-ló i bē tshuā.

細空毋補，大空叫苦。.trs: Sè khang m̄ póo, tuā khang kiò-khóo.

緊紡無好紗，緊嫁無好大家。.trs: Kín pháng bô hó se, kín kè bô hó ta-ke.

翁某若仝心，烏塗變成金。.trs: Ang-bóo nā kāng sim, oo-thôo piàn-sîng kim.

翁親某親，老婆仔拋捙輪。.trs: Ang tshin bóo tshin, lāu-pô-á pha-tshia-lin.

老人毋講古，少年毋捌寶。.trs: Lāu-lâng m̄ kóng-kóo, siàu-liân m̄ bat pó.

耳仔生兩葉，家己看袂著。.trs: Hīnn-á senn nn̄g hio̍h, ka-kī khuànn bē tio̍h.

腹肚若水櫃，胸坎若樓梯。.trs: Pak-tóo ná tsuí-kuī, hing-khám ná lâu-thui.

臭頭仔嘛會做皇帝，做總統你嘛有機會。.trs: Tshàu-thâu-á mā ē tsò hông-tè, tsò tsóng-thóng lí mā ū ki-huē.

花無百日紅，人無千日好。.trs: Hue bô pah ji̍t âng, lâng bô tshian ji̍t hó.

菜蟲食菜，菜跤死。.trs: Tshài thâng tsia̍h tshài, tshài-kha sí.

落水平平沉，全無重頭輕。.trs: Lo̍h tsuí pênn-pênn tîm, tsuân bô tāng-thâu-khin.

行船走馬三分命。.trs: Kiânn-tsûn tsáu bé sann hun miā.

講一个影，生一个囝。.trs: Kóng tsi̍t ê iánn, senn tsi̍t ê kiánn.

豬毋大，大對狗去。.trs: Ti m̄ tuā, tuā tuì káu khì.

豬頭毋顧，顧鴨母卵。.trs: Ti-thâu m̄ kòo, kòo ah-bó nn̄g.

財子壽三字全。.trs: Tsâi tsú siū sann jī tsuân.

買田愛揀好田底，娶某愛揀好娘嬭。.trs: Bé tshân ài kíng hó tshân té, tshuā-bóo ài kíng hó niû-lé.

買賣算分，相請無論。.trs: Bé-bē sǹg hun, sio-tshiánn bô lūn.

賣茶講茶芳，賣花講花紅。.trs: Bē tê kóng tê phang, bē hue kóng hue âng.

趁也著趁，食也著食。.trs: Thàn iā tio̍h thàn, tsia̍h iā tio̍h tsia̍h.

趁錢有數，性命愛顧。.trs: Thàn-tsînn iú sòo, sènn-miā ài kòo.

跋一倒，抾著一隻金雞母。.trs: Pua̍h tsi̍t tó, khioh-tio̍h tsi̍t tsiah kim ke-bó.

輸人毋輸陣，輸陣歹看面。.trs: Su lâng m̄ su tīn, su tīn pháinn-khuànn bīn.

近山剉無柴，近溪擔無水。.trs: Kīn suann tshò bô tshâ, kīn khe tann bô tsuí.

近水知魚性，近山識鳥音。.trs: Kīn suí ti hî sìng, kīn san sik niáu im.

送伊魚，較輸教伊掠魚。.trs: Sàng i hî, khah-su kà i lia̍h hî.

這溪無魚，別溪釣。.trs: Tsit khe bô hî, pa̍t khe tiò.

過橋較濟你行路，食鹽較濟你食米。.trs: Kuè kiô khah tsē lí kiânn-lōo, tsia̍h iâm khah tsē lí tsia̍h bí.

鋪面蟶，浸水蚵。.trs: Phoo bīn than, tsìm tsuí ô .

錢四跤，人兩跤。.trs: Tsînn sì kha, lâng nn̄g kha.

關門著閂，講話著看。.trs: Kuainn-mn̂g tio̍h tshuànn, kóng-uē tio̍h khuànn.

陰鴆陰鴆，咬人三寸深。.trs: Im-thim im-thim, kā lâng sann tshùn tshim.

雙个旋，惡甲無人問。.trs: Siang ê tsn̄g, ok kah bô lâng mn̄g.

雙手抱孩兒，才知爸母時。.trs: Siang-tshiú phō hâi-jî, tsiah tsai pē-bú sî.

雞屎落塗，也有三寸煙。.trs: Ke sái lo̍h thôo, iā ū sann tshùn ian.

靠山山會崩，靠水水會焦。.trs: Khò suann suann ē pang, khò tsuí tsuí ē ta.

頂司管下司，鋤頭管畚箕。.trs: Tíng-si kuán ē-si, tî-thâu kuán pùn-ki.

頂港有名聲，下港上出名。.trs: Tíng-káng ū miâ-siann, ē-káng siōng tshut-miâ.

頭大面四方，肚大居財王。.trs: Thâu tuā bīn sù-hong, tóo tuā ki tsâi-ông.

食人一口，報人一斗。.trs: Tsia̍h lâng tsi̍t kháu, pò lâng tsi̍t táu.

食人一斤，也著還人四兩。.trs: Tsia̍h lâng tsi̍t kin, iā tio̍h hîng lâng sì niú.

食人頭鍾酒，講人頭句話。.trs: Tsia̍h lâng thâu tsing tsiú, kóng lâng thâu kù uē.

食果子拜樹頭；食米飯拜田頭。.trs: Tsia̍h kué-tsí pài tshiū-thâu; tsia̍h bí-pn̄g pài tshân-thâu.

食無三把蕹菜，就欲上西天。.trs: Tsia̍h bô sann pé ìng-tshài, tō beh tsiūnn se-thian.

食甜食鹹，臭跤鼻臁。.trs: Tsia̍h tinn tsia̍h kiâm, tshàu kha-phīnn-liâm.

食米毋知米價。.trs: Tsia̍h bí m̄ tsai bí kè.

食著藥，青草一葉；食毋著藥，人參一石。.trs: Tsia̍h tio̍h io̍h, tshinn-tsháu tsi̍t hio̍h; tsia̍h m̄-tio̍h io̍h, jîn-sim tsi̍t tsio̍h.

食雞，會起家；食鰇魚，生囡仔好育飼。.trs: Tsia̍h ke, ē khí-ke; tsia̍h jiû-hî, senn gín-á hó io-tshī.

食魚食肉，也著菜佮。.trs: Tsia̍h hî tsia̍h bah, iā tio̍h tshài kah.

飼囝無論飯，飼爸母算頓。.trs: Tshī kiánn bô-lūn pn̄g, tshī pē-bú sǹg tǹg.

驚某大丈夫，拍某豬狗牛。.trs: Kiann bóo tāi-tiōng-hu, phah bóo ti káu gû.

龍交龍，鳳交鳳，隱痀的交侗戇。.trs: Lîng kau lîng, hōng kau hōng, ún-ku--ê kau tòng-gōng.

龜笑鱉無尾，鱉笑龜粗皮。.trs: Ku tshiò pih bô bué, pih tshiò ku tshoo phuê.
